# api commands

Every `api` command, with the arguments and options the console actually defines.

## `api:credential:issue`

Issue a machine credential and print its Bearer token, once.

```bash
bin/semitexa api:credential:issue "<client>"
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--scope` | yes |
| `--tenant` | yes |
| `--all-tenants` | no |
| `--expires-in` | yes |
| `--json` | no |

## `api:credential:list`

List machine credentials that are not revoked (expired ones marked): scopes, tenant, expiry, last use.

```bash
bin/semitexa api:credential:list
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--tenant` | yes |
| `--json` | no |

## `api:credential:revoke`

Revoke a machine credential, or with --rotate give it a new secret.

```bash
bin/semitexa api:credential:revoke "<id>"
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--rotate` | no |
